summary: Phase 1 E2E tested (backend pytest 18 tests + Playwright UI on desktop). All 18 requested features work end-to-end: dashboard KPIs/recent projects/activity/quick actions, sidebar nav, project create/search/detail tabs/delete, upload of all 3 .md doc types with metadata + versioning, markdown preview dialog (headings + GFM table render), repo/app config save + persist after reload, providers add/validate/mark-key/delete, model registry register (capabilities+pricing) + delete, audit log filter, settings display. Backend 15/18 passed; the 3 failures are edge-case validation/500 bugs.

minor.issue: 500 Internal Server Error - search string passed raw into Mongo $regex; invalid regex chars crash. Use re.escape(search).
Non-UTF8 .md file -> 500 UnicodeDecodeError (documents.py:36). Wrap decode in try/except and return 400. Also '.MD' uppercase extension rejected (use .lower().endswith).
Empty name '' accepted (201). Add Field(min_length=1) / strip validation to ProjectCreate (and ProviderCreate.name, ModelCreate fields).
log_audit for delete/update/validate/key_configured does not pass resource_name, so Audit Logs and Dashboard activity show '—' / no name for most entries. Fetch name before delete and pass it.
No audit log entry on assignment delete; assignment upsert path also not audited.
provider_type is taken from client and not validated against the provider's actual provider_type.

ui_bugs.issue: Form not reset after successful registration - reopening dialog shows previous model_id/display_name/pricing
No Endpoint URL input even for 'Custom' provider type although backend supports endpoint_url
Document delete (trash icon) has no confirmation, deletes immediately

issues: Provider card dropdown trigger (MoreVertical) lacks data-testid
provider_type rendered with CSS capitalize -> 'Openai' instead of 'OpenAI'
Markdown unordered list bullets not visible (list-style missing in .markdown-content)
All values hardcoded in JSX; not fetched from organizations/users collections

action_items: Escape regex in project search (re.escape) to fix 500
Return 400 for non-UTF8 document uploads instead of 500; accept case-insensitive .md
Add min_length validation on project/provider/model names
Pass resource_name in audit logs for delete/update/validate/key_configured actions
Reset Register Model form after success
Add endpoint URL field for Custom provider type
Add data-testid to provider card menu trigger; confirm before document delete
critical_code_review_comments: log_audit helper duplicated in 4 route files - extract to a shared module
server.py creates an index on _id with custom name 'id_asc' - redundant (Mongo has default _id index) and may log an error at startup
AIModel.__fields__ is deprecated in Pydantic v2 - use ModelCapabilities()/ModelPricing() directly
Dashboard /recent-activity limit is unbounded (no Query ge/le)
No upload size limit on documents
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ projects/providers/models created during tests were deleted by id; seeded 'E-Commerce QA' and 2 providers untouched.
